benchmarkCommitIs: the commit the BINARY was built from, not the repository HEAD when the report was written
oracleNote: DODO and Flashbots consume the same zero-latency oracle; Uniswap V2 and V3 are passive and consume none, so a difference against them contains the oracle repricing advantage as well as curve shape
independenceNote: these results share one seed set, one price path, one order flow and one baseline; significant rows are correlated, not independent experiments
